top.en: Welcome to the League of Legends World Championship. This is the most brutal, most toxic, most hyper-critical, and most result-oriented esports tournament. Here there are no 'so closes', no regrets, no encouragement, no tolerance, no butterflies flying across the sea. Here there is only: whose selfishness is a crime, whose draft gets targeted, who is laning in the jungle, who is kill-stealing in the bot lane, who is shouting retreat on the high ground, who refuses to back off while pushing up, whose playstyle lacks teamplay, who acts like a pig and drags the whole team down, whose [~0:mental is shattered], who needs comforting after losing a game, who lacks all human warmth, who is shouting and barking, whose focus fire is off, who is sad and weeping, whose MVP gets outplayed in the matchup. There is no youthful arrogance here, only winners taking all. Every victory is just bought for a one-day exemption card from flame, so nobody is reimbursing your plane ticket, and your swimming skills better be top-notch. Going 0-3 is called a shocking five-game sweep, 1-3 is basically four-nil, 2-3 is a thrilling full-series loss, round-of-16 custom songs are flying everywhere, getting eliminated in the quarters has you hiding your sweaty neck, losing means swimming home, and finishing as runner-up is just a lucky round-of-16 exit. Only the champions earn respect—and that's a lie too; one title is called luck, one title is called rigged, and even a six-time champion needs a seventh title to prove themselves. Contenders leave their names, clowns reveal their shapes, winning gets you advancing, losing gets you a diss track. Playing well makes you a team, playing poorly makes you a band, playing even worse makes you a band of losers. There is no obligation to baby you, no one cares if your hand hurts, they only care if your hand is broken, if your title is a fraud, if you're hiding your injuries, if your spine is straight, if your [~1:Beyblade is spinning], if your [~2:bathwater is too hot], and whether you died with your eyes closed—lose one game and you're suspected of match-fixing.
